headline: 159 islanders return to Saint Martin's after 10-day absence
summary: Residents who were stranded or away from the island due to weather conditions have finally made their way back home.
details: After a period of 10 days, 159 residents of Saint Martin's Island have finally returned to their homes.
The return of the islanders was made possible as weather conditions improved, allowing ships to resume operations.
Many of these residents had been unable to return to the island due to theabsence of ship services during the period of inclement weather.
The arrival of the islanders has brought relief to their families and families who had been waiting for their return.

headline: Teknaf: Wild mother elephant seriously injured after falling from 300ft hill
summary: Medical treatment is currently underway for the animal following the Prime Minister's orders.
details: A wild mother elephant was seriously injured after falling from a 300-foot-high hill in Teknaf, Cox's Bazar.
The animal suffered severe injuries during the fall, leaving it in a critical condition.
Following the instructions of the Prime Minister, a medical team has been deployed to provide urgent care and treatment to the injured elephant.
Local authorities and wildlife experts are working together to stabilize the animal and ensure its recovery.
caption:
A wild mother elephant fell from a 300ft hill in Teknaf and is now fighting for her life.

A wild mother elephant was seriously injured after falling from a 300-foot-high hill in Teknaf, Cox's Bazar.

The animal suffered severe injuries during the fall, leaving it in a critical condition.

Following the instructions of the Prime Minister, a medical team has been deployed to provide urgent care and treatment to the injured elephant.

Local authorities and wildlife experts are working together to stabilize the animal and ensure its recovery.
